definitions.gloss: number of deaths; death toll; fatality count
definitions.explanation: How many people died from a given cause or in a given period, as reported in official statistics. Formal register: used in government releases, news reports, and research.

examples.japanese: {死亡者数|しぼうしゃすう}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: The number of deaths was announced.

examples.japanese: {交通事故|こうつうじこ}の{死亡者数|しぼうしゃすう}は{年々|ねんねん}{減|へ}っている。
examples.english: The number of traffic accident deaths is falling year by year.

examples.japanese: {感染症|かんせんしょう}の{死亡者数|しぼうしゃすう}は、{年齢|ねんれい}によって{大|おお}きく{異|こと}なる。
examples.english: The number of deaths from infectious disease differs greatly by age.

examples.japanese: {厚生労働省|こうせいろうどうしょう}は、{毎年|まいとし}{死因|しいん}{別|べつ}の{死亡者数|しぼうしゃすう}を{公表|こうひょう}している。
examples.english: The Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare publishes the number of deaths by cause every year.

notes:
Built from {死亡|しぼう} (death) plus {者|しゃ} (person) plus {数|すう} (number). The suffix {数|すう} turns any counted group into its statistic: {感染者数|かんせんしゃすう} (number of infections), {来場者数|らいじょうしゃすう} (attendance).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {死亡者数|しぼうしゃすう}が{増|ふ}える／{減|へ}る: for the death toll to rise / fall
- {死亡者数|しぼうしゃすう}を{発表|はっぴょう}する: to announce the number of deaths
- {累計|るいけい}{死亡者数|しぼうしゃすう}: cumulative death toll

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {死者数|ししゃすう}: death toll — shorter and more common in news headlines; the same meaning
- {犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}: victim — emphasizes that the deaths were caused by a disaster or accident
